125666.overview: Reversi (リバーシ, Ribāshi) is a digital adaptation of the classic board game also known as Othello. Players take turns placing black or white discs on the board, flipping their opponent’s pieces by trapping them between their own. Victory goes to the player with the most discs of their color when the board is full. Reversi on the Game Pocket Computer preserves the strategic gameplay of the original, offering a competitive and cerebral experience for portable play.

125691.overview: Mahjongg (マージャン, Mājan) brings the traditional Chinese tile-based game to the Epoch Game Pocket Computer, offering a strategic and engaging experience. Players aim to complete winning hands by forming sets and pairs while drawing and discarding tiles. This version faithfully captures the core mechanics of Mahjong, allowing both seasoned players and newcomers to enjoy the depth of the classic game in a portable format.

146065.overview: 11-Puzzle (Puzzle Game, パズルゲーム, Pazurugēmu)  is a sliding tile puzzle game that challenges players to arrange numbered tiles in sequential order. Players must slide tiles one at a time into an empty space to solve the puzzle, testing their logic and planning skills. With its minimalist presentation and brain-teasing design, 11-Puzzle offers a portable and classic puzzle-solving experience ideal for short bursts of play or extended mental challenges.
